bugs.title: Jest mocking fails with circular dependencies
bugs.description: When attempting to mock UserRepository in controller tests, Jest throws circular dependency errors due to module-load-time instantiation. Controller instantiates repository at module-load time, causing Jest mock hoisting issues.

resolution.approach: Switched to integration-style tests with real DB instead of mocked repository
resolution.rationale: Avoid Jest mocking complexity, use real database for simpler tests. Integration-style unit tests provide same coverage without mocking fragility.

bugs.workaround: Use integration tests instead of unit tests with mocks
bugs.prevention: Document in learnings: Prefer integration-style tests for layered architecture to avoid Jest mocking complexity

bugs.title: TypeScript type error with Express Request and AuthenticatedRequest
bugs.description: Controller expects AuthenticatedRequest (custom type with user property) but Express route handlers expect standard Request type. Type mismatch causes compilation error when wiring controller to route.

resolution.approach: Use wrapper function pattern: (req, res) => controller(req as AuthenticatedRequest, res)
resolution.rationale: Maintains type safety without Express type conflicts. Wrapper function allows type assertion at the boundary.

bugs.prevention: Document: Use wrapper pattern for Express routes with custom request types. Standard pattern for auth middleware integration.
